title: Herbal Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy vegetarian stir fry made with crunchy low-fat ingredients, infused with herbal flavors.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of herbal oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the broccoli, carrots, and bell peppers. Cook for 3-4 minutes, or until the vegetables start to soften.
Add the garlic and ginger. Cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Pour in the low-fat stir fry sauce and stir to coat the vegetables.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the sesame seeds and crunchy fried shallots.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional sesame seeds and crunchy fried shallots, if desired.
